question: I have a question. On Volume 27, page 130, Sanji says to pour the water into the canteen if the pot inside fills up from the steam droplets, but how exactly does this survival technique work? Please tell me now. -by Kagawa-
answer: Oh, here's a diagram of getting drinking water via steam. <- Set up 3 pots like so. We'll be using water from a river. The "water 2" is there to cool the rising steam. The rising steam, once cooled, will change into water droplets and drop back down into the middle pot, giving us clean drinkable water. In Sanji's case, he used "Sea clouds". Now that you know this, you'll be able to make water anywhere! O: My result. It's better not to draw with one's mouth. Now please, don't ask me to do this ever again. my front teeth all hurt now! They're about to break! See you again next volume, SBS!
name: Kagawa
